items.name: Cubing Returns Bengaluru 2022

venue.name: Vega City Mall, Dollar Layout, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076
venue.address: Vega City Mall, Dollar Layout, Bannerghatta Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076

items.information:
Please note once you register in WCA site for the Cubing Returns Bengaluru 2022, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. The duties will be assigned by a software and finalised by the organising team in consultation with the delegates. This information will be provided to all participants at least 2 days before the event. We will also ensure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.

**Important Note: Since accepting the registrations is manually done, please wait for 2 days before your registration is accepted, after paying the registration fees **

COVID-19 Specific Information:
* Wearing masks, Sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders is mandatory while attending the competition.

items.name: Farnworth Spring C 2022
items.information:
### This competition is part of a series. This means that competitors are only allowed to compete in ONE competition in this series. Please read the **Series Competition** tab for more information.

**ALL** competitors must read the **COVID-19** tab to make sure that they are aware of the differences to prior competitions in the UK.

Please read through all the other tabs in this page as they contain important infomation to the competition.

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.name: Buckeye Blind Off 2022

venue.name: [Ohio Union, The Ohio State University](https://ohiounion.osu.edu)
venue.details: Barbie Tootle Room - third floor, northwest corner of the building

items.information:
**This competition will only hold blindfolded events!** First time competitors are welcome, but we will not be holding traditional events like 3x3x3 or Pyraminx.

This competiton will feature two Extra Events: 3x3x3 Team-Blind and Mirror Blocks Blindfolded. You must be registered for this competition in order to compete in either extra event.

Only one guest per competitor is permitted.
